assignments.reason: נִמְשָׁךְ רַחֲמָנוּת (compassion flows) is, by essential nature, compassion itself — the same concept as רחמנות in Package 1, expressed in its actualized, flowing form. The Rebbe's chain reads: 'נִמְתָּק הַחֲרוֹן-אַף, וְנִמְשָׁךְ רַחֲמָנוּת' — and then immediately defines what this compassion IS: 'וְעִקָּר רַחֲמָנוּת הוּא בִּבְחִינַת... וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יִתֵּן לָכֶם רַחֲמִים'. The 'compassion that flows' is identical in essential nature to the compassion-placed-in-human-hands that defines Package 1.

נִמְתָּק הַחֲרוֹן-אַף (the fierce anger is sweetened) is, by essential nature, the emergence of divine mercy — it is the positive face of compassion. The Rebbe presents sweetening of anger and flowing of compassion as a single unified outcome: 'נִמְתָּק הַחֲרוֹן-אַף, וְנִמְשָׁךְ רַחֲמָנוּת'. The sweetening IS the compassion arriving; it is not a separate intermediate step with its own distinct nature. Its essential quality is mercy/compassion, placing it in Package 1.

מַסְעֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל (the journeys of the children of Israel) — while these function as a CAUSE in the eitza chain, the assignment question is about essential nature. The Rebbe closes the Torah by equating ישראל itself with compassion (ישראל = ראשי תיבות אל שדי יתן לכם רחמים) and states 'כִּי הָרַחֲמָנוּת נַעֲשָׂה עַל-יְדֵי מַסְעֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל' — compassion is MADE through Israel's journeys. The journeys are Israel's essential holy practice, and ישראל (via the additions file) is already assigned to Package 1. The journeys of Israel are Israel's compassion-generating identity in action — they belong to the good/compassion domain.

נְסִיעוֹת (journeys) is explicitly equated with מסעי בני ישראל by the Rebbe: 'מַסְעֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, דְּהַיְנוּ הַנְּסִיעוֹת שֶׁבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נוֹסְעִין מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם'. The word דהינו (meaning 'that is') marks this as the same concept restated. Its essential nature is identical to מסעי בני ישראל — Israel's holy journeys, belonging to the compassion domain of Package 1.

כְּשֶׁנִּתְכַּפֵּר פְּגַם עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה (when the blemish of idolatry is atoned) — while the כשנתכפר framing describes a positive process, the essential nature of this node is פְּגַם עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, the blemish of idolatry. It is the evil that is being addressed. The additions file already identified פגם עבודה זרה as belonging to Package 2 (evil). This compound node's core identity is the idolatry-blemish; the 'atonement' is the eitza action performed upon it, not its essential nature.

assignments.node_id: מכפרין על אלה אלקיך ישראל, הינו על פגם עבודה זרה
assignments.reason: מְכַפְּרִין עַל אֵלֶּה אֱלֹקֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל, הַיְנוּ עַל פְּגַם עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה — this node explicitly references the sin of the golden calf ('these are your gods, Israel') and equates it with the blemish of idolatry. By essential nature, this IS the blemish of idolatry as described in Package 2. The מכפרין (atoning) wrapper describes the eitza action, but the object being described — the thing itself — is the evil of idolatry, placing it squarely in the evil Package 2.
